$Comment: Names the hytale:held_item reading for requirement lines. The pattern points straight at the engine's own item name catalogue, so a requirement to hold a specific item reads with that item's shipped display name in the viewer's language; an item id with no shipped name, and a name pattern (Tool_Pickaxe_*, matched along the item's Parent lineage), fall back to the factor's own name below. Holding another item reads a definite 0 (AbsentReads), so a condition on it needs Min 1.
